Name: I'm in love - Hearts hats
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][i][b][center]~ "I'm In Love" ~[/center][/b][/i]
[/size][size=4][center]Either you love someone else or yourself, love is something to express![/center]
[/size]
So I'll be kind of slowly coming back to Nexus, now, with this little mod

It's a pretty simple mod, it adds 10 new hats that you can get from the mouse's shop!
We have red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, black... And a rainbow one. AND an LGBTQ+ one too! 

[b][i][u]If you don't want any of them to show up, simply delete any of the folders![/u][/i][/b]

I'm open to any suggestions!!


[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]
